context: A retired banker mentors a younger boss over coffee
purpose: Teach: 利子/就労/運輸/納め/間隔/有益/問合せ/外観

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君も社長になって一年か。なにしろ運輸業界は今が踏ん張りどころだぞ。
lines.en: A year as president already, huh. The transport industry is at a critical point right now.
lines.style: Warm mentor tone, slow and reflective with a touch of gravitas.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、銀行からの融資の利子も上がってきて、正直ちょっぴり不安です。
lines.en: Yes, the interest on the bank loans has gone up, and honestly I'm a little anxious.
lines.style: Younger executive, candid and slightly deferential to his mentor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 焦るな。私が現役の頃は、決算と決算の間隔を意識して資金繰りを組んだものだ。
lines.en: Don't rush. In my active days, I always planned cash flow mindful of the gap between closings.
lines.style: Calm, instructive elder sharing seasoned wisdom over coffee.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。先日いただいた助言、本当に有益でした。社員の就労環境も見直しています。
lines.en: I see. The advice you gave me the other day was truly valuable. I'm also reviewing employee working conditions.
lines.style: Grateful and earnest, taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それでいい。税金もきちんと納めて、客からの問合せ一つにも丁寧に応じる。基本だよ。
lines.en: That's the spirit. Pay your taxes properly, and respond carefully even to a single customer inquiry. It's the basics.
lines.style: Firm yet gentle, emphasizing fundamentals like a seasoned banker.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は本社ビルの外観もそろそろ改修したくて、来月見積もりを取る予定なんです。
lines.en: Actually, I want to renovate the exterior of the head office building soon. I'm getting estimates next month.
lines.style: Shifting topic, eager to share plans with his mentor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほう、見栄えも大事だが、まずは中身。社員を大切にすれば、会社は自然と立派になる。
lines.en: Hoh, appearance matters, but content comes first. Treasure your people, and the company will naturally grow strong.
lines.style: Philosophical close, gentle smile of a retired veteran.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。今日もまた、教わってばかりですね。
lines.en: I'll carve those words into my heart. Today again, I've done nothing but learn from you.
lines.style: Humble closing remark, slight bow implied in tone.
